statements.statement: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0, I48.91)
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is required
The service is needed to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The service is needed to optimize rate control
The service is needed to assess further arrhythmic burden
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service was rejected because it is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
